paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: : (a) The impact of hyperparameter N on F1 score. (b) The impact of hyperparameter N on AUC.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the hyperparameter N and the Area Under the Curve (AUC). The x-axis, labeled ‘N’, ranges from 0 to 20, utilizing a linear scale with tick intervals of 1, and the y-axis represents ‘AUC (%)’ ranging from approximately 85 to 99.5, also on a linear scale with tick intervals of 0.5. There are six lines in the plot, each corresponding to a different color and marker style. A purple line displays a solid style and circles, beginning at approximately 85.5% at N=0 and declining to approximately 78% at N=20. A red line uses a solid style and squares, starting at approximately 90% at N=0 and decreasing to approximately 85% at N=20. A green line is depicted with a solid style and triangles, beginning at approximately 96% at N=0 and decreasing to approximately 91% at N=20. An orange line is represented using a solid style and diamonds, starting at approximately 89% at N=0 and ending at approximately 87% at N=20. A blue line is shown with a solid style and circles, beginning at approximately 95% at N=0 and decreasing to approximately 92% at N=20. Finally, a teal line utilizes a solid style and asterisks, starting at approximately 92% at N=0 and ending at approximately 89% at N=20.
